mainEntity.name: How much does a new roof cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Averages $8,000-$20,000 for asphalt shingles ($5-10/sq ft installed); metal $10-25/sq ft; tile $15-30/sq ft. Factors: size, pitch, materials, location, removal fees. Get multiple quotes.
